# Masterplan

## Build path

Path: Explore privately
Why: A weekend experiment to see whether the allotment rota can live in one
page. Nobody relies on it, the data can be thrown away, and nothing it does
is hard to undo.
Access: private
Sensitive areas: none
Accepted: none
Recheck when: anyone else asks to use it; it holds anything we would miss.
Last checked: 2026-09-30

## What it does, and for whom

Plot Rota shows who waters the shared allotment on which day. Four neighbours
use it. Before it, they shared a message thread that nobody could search.

## What happens when it fails

If it stops, the thread is still there. Nothing is lost.

## Out of scope

Seed ordering and money. Neither is part of the experiment.
